fields.name: 🚚 RFID Dock Portal Transit & Directionality Monitor

query.sql: SELECT "$when" AS timestamp, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.portal_id') AS portal, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.direction') AS direction, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.pallet_sscc') AS pallet_sscc, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.item_count') AS INTEGER) AS items, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.estimated_velocity_mps') AS REAL) AS velocity_mps, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.mean_transit_rssi_dbm') AS REAL) AS rssi_dbm, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.status') AS status FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'PortalTransitEvent' ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT "$when" AS timestamp, "$type" AS message_type, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.standard') AS epc_standard, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.canonical_urn') AS canonical_urn, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.company_prefix') AS company_prefix, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.antenna_id') AS INTEGER) AS antenna, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.peak_rssi_dbm') AS REAL) AS rssi_dbm FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" LIKE 'Epc%Read' ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 30

view.title: Multi-Standard GS1 EPC Ingress Stream (SGTIN, SSCC, SGLN, GRAI, GIAI...)

query.sql: SELECT "$when" AS timestamp, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.antenna_name') AS antenna_name, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.antenna_id') AS INTEGER) AS antenna_id, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.tx_power_cdbm') AS REAL) / 100.0 AS tx_power_dbm, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.mean_rssi_dbm') AS REAL) AS mean_rssi, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.reflection_vswr') AS REAL) AS vswr, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.read_rate_tps') AS REAL) AS tag_rate_tps, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.status') AS health FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'RfidAntennaTelemetry' ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 20
